data.title: Emergencies — Beginner · Lesson 3
data.subject: emergencies
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Hey, hey…

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
What's the deal?… ¿Qué tal?
Let's go… Vámonos
New friends today… Nuevos amigos hoy
In the neighborhood.

[Verse]
Saw a sign, "Bienvenidos"
Neighbors moving in, can't you see?
Nice to meet you… Mucho gusto
Smiling faces all around.
Lifeguard… Socorrista
If you need one by the pool.
First aid kit… Botiquín
Just in case, you know the rules.
The pet… La mascota
Running in the yard with glee.
Tow truck… Grúa
If your car gets stuck, oh me.

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
What's the deal?… ¿Qué tal?
Let's go… Vámonos
New friends today… Nuevos amigos hoy
In the neighborhood.

[Verse]
Heard a sound, "¡Cuidado!"
Storm is coming, skies look gray.
Storm… Tormenta
Better find some shelter fast.
Seat belt… Cinturón
Always buckle up, don't delay.
Officer… Agente
Keeping us safe on the way.
Injury… Herida
If you fall, we'll help you stay.

[Bridge]
The ambulance… La ambulancia
On its way if you should call.
Neighbors helping neighbors, that's the way we roll.
